name: Kurumizawa Kumiko
source:
She’s a waitress at a café on the campus of the university the protagonist attends. While there are several part-time workers, she’s the only full-time employee, so she effectively serves as the manager.

She’s working hard at this job that requires her to be in the public eye because she wants to overcome her shy personality.

She has a natural maid-like disposition, whether it's if the protagonist gets an erection, or if he cums inside her, she will express her gratitude and joy from the bottom of her heart.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/227185/]Getchu[/url]]
